prompt:
Generate a polished single game loading screen concept for PROJECT VERTEX, 1920x1080 landscape. Image1 is ONLY a layout reference: centered emblem, quiet pale geometric environment, one thin horizontal progress line. Ignore all video-player controls, bottom pink scrubber, browser/capture border, and the other game's linked-chain logo. Image2 is our game's established design-language reference: off-white paper, ink-black angular cuts, thin architectural rules, tiny diamond/cross registration details, cyan accent.
Design an elegant extremely restrained VERTEX loading screen. Very pale cool off-white #EEF0F2 background with large almost-flat polygonal facets suggestive of distant mountains and overlapping clipped sheets. Slight fine paper grain, low contrast, broad uninterrupted whitespace. NOT a glossy 3D render, not busy tech circuitry, not decorative fantasy.
One original ink #16181B emblem slightly ABOVE center, around x960,y380: a sharp four-point Vertex star centered in a broken diamond frame; flat graphic, compact strong silhouette, subtle angular cuts and paper-white negative space. This is a concept emblem consistent with the game's four-point-star motif, do NOT copy image1's interlocking chain logo. Small widely tracked wordmark "VERTEX" below, then smaller Korean "기록을 불러오는 중..." below it.
At y690 one single fine progress track spanning almost the full canvas with 80px side margins, gray unfinished part and solid cyan #0DB8F2 finished portion at 68 percent; a tiny cyan diamond at the current progress endpoint. No rainbow gradient, no red or gold. Put small "68%" aligned near the far right immediately below the track. Only sparse small corner registration crosses and miniature thin angular line segments. Bottom left tiny uppercase "FIELD GUIDE" and one Korean tip on next line: "동료의 호감도가 오르면 새로운 기록이 열립니다." Bottom right tiny "PROJECT VERTEX / ARCHIVE". At most two text hierarchy levels besides wordmark; tip quiet and subtle.
Balanced minimalist game-native loading screen, clean readable Korean, black emblem as focal point, no character, no menus, no merchandise, no back button, no inset, no device frame, no watermark. Output only finished screenshot, not a comparison sheet.
notes: Concept emblem using four-point Vertex motif, not a canonical logo replacement.
Progress and tip are illustrative; source retained and delivery resized.
